The '''Grand Experiment''' was conceived by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis's]] desire to create a [[Species/Legends|life form]] by [[Midi-chlorian manipulation|gaining control]] of the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]], the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] microscopic organisms that enabled [[Force-sensitive/Legends|certain beings]] to wield the [[Force power/Legends|power]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Not only did the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] deem the project a failure, his efforts ultimately backfired and caused the midi-chlorians to create [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the prophesied [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] legend who was destined to restore balance to the Force by destroying the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==History==
During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], conducted the Grand Experiment on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]] in [[42 BBY/Legends|42 BBY]]. Utilizing [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Plagueis intended to create the living embodiment of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. In order to do so, he tried to [[Midi-chlorian manipulation|influence]] the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] in his attempt to create life. But when his efforts bore no success, and instead wiped out his other experiments, Plagueis deemed the project a failure. Years later, during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Crisis on Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Plagueis was surprised to discover the existence of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] born without a [[Parent/Legends|father]]. Plagueis concluded that not only had the midi-chlorians resisted his will, but they had also retaliated by engineering the conception of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] long-awaited [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] destined to restore balance to the Force by destroying the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Plagueisnovel" />

Unlike his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], however, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious saw the discovery of Skywalker as an opportunity; the chance to use the Jedi's own legend to the Sith's advantage. After he [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] Plagueis, Sidious&mdash;under the guise of his public persona as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine&mdash;befriended the young [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]], and intended to slowly corrupt him over the years until Skywalker submitted to the dark side&mdash;a goal in which he ultimately succeeded.<ref name="Plagueisnovel" /> However, Anakin was eventually redeemed and, turning his back on his Master and the dark side, slew the Emperor before he himself perished.
